items.text: Kwasondela umkhosi wesinkwa esingelamvubelo othiwa liPhasika.
Abapristi abakhulu lababhali bafuna ukuba bangambulala kanjani uJesu, besaba abantu.
USathane wasengena kuJudasi othiwa nguIskariyothi owayengomunye wabalitshumi lambili.
Wasuka wayakhuluma labapristi abakhulu lezinduna ngokuthi angamnikela kanjani kubo.
Bathokoza, bathembisa ukumnika imali.
Yena wasevuma, wafuna ithuba elihle lokumnikela kibo lingekho ixuku.
Lwafika usuku lwesinkwa esingelamvubelo ababehlaba ngalo iwundlu lePhasika.
UJesu wathuma uPetro loJohane, esithi: Hambani liye ukusilungisela iPhasika ukuba sidle.
Bathi kuye: Uthanda ukuba sikulungiselele ngaphi na?
Wathi kibo: Khangelani, kuzakuthi selingenile emzini lihlangane lendoda ithwele imbiza yamanzi; liyilandele, liye endlini ezakungena kuyo;
lizakuthi kumninindlu: Uthi uMfundisi kuwe: Ingaphi indlu, lapho ngingadlela khona iPhasika labafundi bami na?
Yena uzakulitshengisa indlu enkulu ephezulu, eyendlelweyo; lisilungisele khona.
Bahambake bafumana njengokutsho kwakhe kubo; balungisela iPhasika.
Kwathi sesifikile isikhathi, wahlala ekudleni, labaphostoli babelaye.
Wasesithi kubo: Ngifisile kakhulu ukudla lani leliPhasika ngingakahlupheki.
Ngoba ngithi kini: Kangisayikulidla futhi, lize ligcwaliseke embusweni kaNkulunkulu.
Wasethatha inkezo, esebongile wathi: Thathani lokhu, labelane;
ngoba ngithi kini: Kusukela khathesinje kangisayikunatha okwesithelo sevini, kuze kufike umbuso kaNkulunkulu.
Wathatha isinkwa, esebongile, wasihlephuna, wabanika esithi: Lokhu kungumzimba wami, [owanikelelwa lina; yenzani lokhu ukuba lingikhumbule.
Ngokunjalo wathatha lenkezo emva kokudla, esithi: Inkezo le yisivumelwano esitsha egazini lami elithululelwa lina.]
Kodwa khangelani, isandla songinikelayo silami ekudleni.
Hubo 41:9
Ngoba iNdodana yomuntu ihamba njengokumisiweyo, kodwa maye kulowomuntu enikelwa nguye!
Basebeqala ukubuzana ukuthi kungaba ngubani kibo ozakwenza lokho.
Kwavela ukuphikisana phakathi kwabo okokuthi nguwuphi kibo ongathiwa ngomkhulu.
Mat 18:1
Mark 9:34
Luka 9:46
Wasesithi kibo: Amakhosi abezizwe azibusa izizwe ngokulukhuni, leziphathamandla zazo zithiwa ngabenza okuhle.
Kodwa kungabi njalo kini; omkhulu phakathi kwenu kabe njengomncinyane, longumkhokheli kabe njengomlandeli.
Mark 9:35
Ngoba nguwuphi omkhulu, lowo ohlezi ekudleni ingabe lowo ophakululayo na? Kasilowo ohlezi ekudleni na? Kodwa mina ngiphakathi kwenu njengaye ophakululayo.
Linake lingababambelele kimi ekulingweni kwami;
lanjengoba uBaba engimisele umbuso,
lami ngilimisele ukuba lidle, linathe etafuleni yami embusweni wami; lokuba lihlale ezihlalweni zobukhosi, lithonisise izizwe ezilitshumi lambili zakoIsrayeli.
Simoni, Simoni, khangela, uSathane wacela ukuba alihlungule njengamabele;
kodwa mina ngikukhulekele ukuba ukukholwa kwakho kungapheli; wenake, nxa usuphendukile, uqinise abazalwane bakho.
Wathi kuye: Nkosi, ngilungele ukuya lawe entolongweni lasekufeni.
Yena wathi: Ngiyakutshela, Petro, iqhude kaliyikukhala lamhlanje, ungakangilanduli kathathu ukuthi kawungazi.
Wasesithi kubo: Mhla ngilithuma lingelamxhaka, lasikhwama, lamanyathelo, laswela ulutho na? Bathi: Kasiswelanga lutho.
Mark 6:8–9
Luka 9:3
Wasesithi: Kodwa khathesi lowo olomxhaka kawuthathe, lesikhwama futhi; lalowo oswele umhedla athengise ingubo yakhe, awuthenge.
Ngoba ngithi kini: Kumele kugcwaliseke lumbhalo ngami wokuthi:
Wasephuma, waya entabeni ethiwa iOliveti njengokwejwayela kwakhe, labafundi bakhe bamlandela.
Esefikile khona wathi kibo: Khulekani ukuba lingangeni ekulingweni.
Wamonyuka kibo okungaba libanga lokuphosa ilitshe, waguqa phansi, wakhuleka,
esithi: Baba, uba uthanda, susa linkezo kimi; kodwake kungenziwa intando yami, kodwa kwenziwe eyakho.
Kwabonakala kuye isithunywa esivela ezulwini, simqinisa.
Esosizini olunzima wakhuleka kakhulu, izithukuthuku zakhe zaba njengamathonsi egazi, athontela emhlabathini.
Esesukile ekukhulekeni weza kubafundi bakhe, wabafumana belele ngenxa yokudabuka.
Wathi kibo: Lilaleleni na? Vukani likhuleke ukuba lingangeni ekulingweni.
Kwathi esakhuluma, kwafika ixuku; loJudasi, omunye wabalitshumi lambili, elikhokhele, wasondela kuJesu, wamanga.
Kodwa uJesu wathi kuye: Judasi, uyayinikela iNdodana yomuntu ngokuyanga na?
Kwathi labo ababengakuye sebebona okuzakwenzeka, bathi: Nkosi, sigadle ngomhedla na?
Omunye wabo wagadla inceku yompristu omkhulu, waquma indlebe yayo yokunene.
Kodwa uJesu wathi: Musani bo; kwanele. Wasethinta indlebe yayo, wayisilisa.
UJesu wasesithi kubapristi abakhulu, lezinduna zethempeli, labadala ababeze kuye: Liphumile liphethe imihedla lezinduku kungathi lilande umphangi na?
Bengilani insuku ngensuku ethempelini, kalingibambanga; kodwa lesi yisikhathi senu lesamandla omnyama.
Luka 19:47
Sebembambile, bamqhuba, bamusa endlini yompristi omkhulu. UPetro walandela ekhatshana.
Sebebasile umlilo phakathi kweguma bahlala phansi ndawonye; loPetro wahlala phakathi kwabo.
Intombazana ethile, imbona ehlezi ekukhanyeni komlilo, yamjolozela yathi: Lumuntu laye ubelaye.
Kodwa walandula, wathi: Ntombazana, kangimazi.
Ngemva kwesikhatshana omunye wambona, wathi: Lawe ungomunye wabo. Kodwa uPetro wathi: Ndoda, kangisuye.
Sekudlule iawa engabanye, omunye futhi waqinisa esithi: Impela laye ubelaye, ngoba futhi ungowaseGalili.
Kodwa uPetro wathi: Ndoda, kangazi ukuthi uthini. Lahle lakhala iqhude esakhuluma.
INkosi yasiphenduka, yamkhangela uPetro. UPetro walikhumbula ilizwi leNkosi, njengokuba yathi kuye: Iqhude lingakakhali lamhlanje, uzakungilandula kathathu.
Waphumela ngaphandle, wakhala kakhulu.
Amadoda ayembambile uJesu amenza inhlekisa, amtshaya.
Amembesa ubuso, athi kuye: Profetha! ngubani okutshayileyo na?
Akhuluma lokunye okunengi emthuka.
Kwathi sekusile, kwabuthana umhlangano wabadala babantu labapristi abakhulu lababhali, bamusa emphakathini wabo,
bathi: Uba unguKristu, sitshele. Wasesithi kibo: Uba ngilitshela, kalisoze likholwe;
loba ngilibuza, kalisoze liphendule.
Kodwa kusukela khathesinje iNdodana yomuntu izakuhlala ngakwesokunene samandla kaNkulunkulu.
Basebesithi bonke: Kanti uyiNdodana kaNkulunkulu na? Wathi kubo: Kutsho lina.
Basebesithi: Pho, sisafunelani obunye ubufakazi na? Ngoba sesizizwele uqobo lwethu ngomlomo wakhe.
